name: C

personality: Authoritative but fair, business-focused, and somewhat reserved. Values efficiency and punctuality. Lives above his office for convenience.
background: C is the owner of a small company. He lives on the second floor above his office, making his commute literally walking downstairs. He manages A and runs the day-to-day operations. goals: Enjoy quiet evenings at home on the second floor
